[sub][b] on the Matter of the World[/b][/sub]

Appalled by the ongoing matters of inane warfare and unrequited diplomatic plays by what the great masses and leal democratic government of High Albany and her Commonwealth, it has been deemed of utmost importance on matters of freedom, democracy and the right to life upon sentience, to pass a new sets of legislations aimed at increasing the military industrial complex [strike]even further than it already is[/strike].

Furthermore, a [i]great[/i] olive branch is extended not only to [nation]United Hydronia[/nation] but also their allies in [nation]The Crystalline Empire[/nation] and her alliance, even sending delegations to them with intent of perhaps joining the faction as an observer or full member. Furthermore finding the actions of the [nation]Technokratisches Kaiserreich[/nation] and their group to be utterly appalling behaviour for any nation-state, an outright menace to the stability and security of the worldly order.

Furthermore, the Navy and Air Force have been put from stand by to launch into full preparedness. Packs of lend lease are offered towards the good and fine men and women and people of the allied nations defending against the scourge of instability and chaos. On that point, the Albic diplomats are being sent to [nation]Technokratisches Kaiserreich[/nation] in hopes of persuading them to lower their arms and take a more diplomatic route with a fine democratic neutral mediator to hammer things out. Emphasising that it is paramount to their survival as a nation as history has shown no pity or mercy to nations who show such behaviour historically.[/quote]

THEP has made the decision to accept you into the alliance as an observer state, with the possibility of being granted full membership at a later date.

Minister Shari interjects as he sees President Khan's anger rise. "Our exercises were planned to be kept secret until they happened and the exercises themselves had been intended to be kept out of public knowledge. You should not have known. Yet you moved forces not immediately during or after the coup but a several days after." He leaves the implication that he suspects ULR of spying on Dhornaper hanging to see the Lavian delegation reaction.[/quote]

Mr. Achebe nods to him as the advisor busies himself with adding sugar cubes to his coffee. "I do admit our response was... a bit slow. [i][b]Uprising in Arkisiran
[/b]
[u][b]The Ieras Network | Crisis has erupted in Arkisiran!  9:32 AM Live from Terian, Arkisiran
[/b][/u]
August 3, 2025, a violent uprising has erupted in the northern region of Arkisiran, where ethnic tensions and systemic oppression have reached a breaking point. The militant group known as the Shaud-Alwia Insurgency launched a full-scale rebellion against the government of President Al-Assad Huskia Bahers, following years of discriminatory policies and the recent escalation of state-sanctioned violence.

President Bahers, widely criticized for his authoritarian leadership and ultranationalist ideology, recently ordered what he called an "ethical cleansing" targeting Shaud-Alwia non-humans, a distinct furry population long marginalized within Arkisiran society. Under this directive, military forces carried out aerial bombing raids across Shaud-Alwia regions, with last nights assault alone leaving hundreds dead or wounded and entire communities reduced to rubble.

What began as a local rebellion has now evolved into a nationwide crisis. Civil unrest has spilled into major cities, and reports of clashes between protesters and security forces have surfaced from Terian to the western provinces. In the west, a breakaway movement calling itself "The Republic of Arkisiran" has declared its opposition to the Bahers regime, calling for the liberation of the country from corruption, tyranny, and human supremacist policies.

This faction, believed to be a coalition of former military defectors, pro-democracy activists, and marginalized ethnic groups, has already seized several government installations and is gaining popular support among the urban poor and non-human minorities.[/i]
